! Dell OS10 Switch Configuration
! Sample config for parser testing — VLT spine/leaf topology

hostname leaf01
!
interface mgmt1/1/1
 description OOB Management
 no shutdown
 ip address 192.168.1.101/24
!
interface ethernet1/1/1
 description VLTi-link-to-leaf02
 no shutdown
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.255.1/30
!
interface ethernet1/1/2
 description VLTi-link-to-leaf02
 no shutdown
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.255.5/30
!
interface ethernet1/1/3
 description server-rack1-port01
 no shutdown
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
!
interface ethernet1/1/4
 description server-rack1-port02
 no shutdown
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 20
 spanning-tree portfast
!
interface ethernet1/1/5
 description PoC-to-spine01
 no shutdown
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
 switchport trunk native vlan 200
 channel-group 10 mode active
!
interface ethernet1/1/6
 description PoC-to-spine02
 no shutdown
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
 switchport trunk native vlan 200
 channel-group 11 mode active
!
interface ethernet1/1/7
 description unused-port
 shutdown
!
interface ethernet1/1/8
 description routed-link-to-firewall
 no shutdown
 no switchport
 ip address 10.0.0.1/30
!
interface vlan10
 description Users gateway
 no shutdown
 ip address 10.0.10.1/24
!
interface vlan20
 description Servers gateway
 no shutdown
 ip address 10.0.20.1/24
!
interface loopback0
 description Router-ID
 no shutdown
 ip address 10.255.255.10/32
!
interface port-channel10
 description VLT-port-channel-to-spine01
 no shutdown
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
 vlt-port-channel 10
!
interface port-channel11
 description VLT-port-channel-to-spine02
 no shutdown
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
 vlt-port-channel 11
!
vlt-domain 1
 discovery-interface ethernet1/1/1
 peer-link port-channel1
 backup destination 192.168.1.102
 vlt-mac 00:00:00:00:00:01
 delay-restore 90
 peer-routing
!
interface port-channel1
 description VLT-peer-link
 no shutdown
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 10.0.0.2
ip route 10.0.0.0/8 192.168.1.254 1
ip route 172.16.0.0/16 10.255.255.2 tag 100
!
ip access-list ACL-INBOUND
 seq 10 permit tcp 10.0.10.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 443
 seq 20 permit tcp 10.0.20.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.10 eq 22
 seq 30 deny ip any any log
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.255.255.10
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0.0.0.0
 network 10.0.10.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.0
 network 10.0.20.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.0
!
router bgp 65001
 router-id 10.255.255.10
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 description spine01
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 update-source loopback0
 neighbor 10.0.0.5 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.0.0.5 description spine02
 neighbor 10.0.0.5 update-source loopback0
 network 10.0.10.0/24
 network 10.0.20.0/24
 maximum-paths 4
